experiment: Held-out composition generalization for PoL2 embodied contract v0.2

design.scope: narrow synthetic operationalization; not complete PoL2
design.train_validation: canonical transfer state and states with at most one factor changed from it
design.test: all unique generated states with at least two factor deviations from canonical transfer state; two new task phrasings and new entity identifiers
design.oracle: separate interpreter of frozen contract clauses; does not call pilot.policy_target
design.labels: programmatic contract outputs, not independent physical or philosophical ground truth
limitations: Both arms learn from the same set of single-rule cases; this tests composition rather than acquisition from zero.
The full theory remains broader than the operational contract.
Finite synthetic combinations cannot establish complete theory possession.
The model has seen the factor values but not multi-failure combinations during train or validation.

always_inspect.note: constant action baseline; shown to demonstrate that admissibility alone can be achieved without rule-composition competence

oracle_differential_audit.note: implementation agreement checks transcription consistency against the pilot function; neither code path independently validates the philosophical mapping
